name: Glass Refraction Panel
description: A real refractive frosted-glass card rendered in raw WebGL over an animated Sand & Surf background, with chromatic aberration, frost blur, a specular edge highlight, and a draggable panel that refracts the background live.
usage: Add a full-bleed <canvas>, then call initGlassRefraction(canvas, opts) and drag the glass; it returns { set, destroy }.
